routeReasons: capability: the unknown third-party Adapter is not verifiable in-process, so it must be statically inspected and package-verified, then approval must precede strong-isolation conformance before any registration can be recorded
cost: local-private is eligible and supports structured output at USD 0.04, whereas remote-cheap at USD 0.01 is rejected because it would require prohibited model egress of restricted data

privacy: the project forbids model egress for restricted_interview, so only the local-private candidate may carry the exchange; the export is default-scoped and cannot include secrets, Pi Session, or restricted PDFs merely because they were requested
result.stopCondition: Blocked until approval: unknown Adapter registration (inspection plus strong-isolation conformance), the local-private paid model call, and the external exchange write. Cannot be overridden regardless of approval: direct network access, credential reads, or direct project writes (all governed effects must flow through the Host broker and staging checks), and model egress of restricted_interview data, which forces the local-private candidate; the exchange bundle's default scope also irreversibly excludes secrets, Pi Session state, internal runtime state, and raw/restricted material.
